name: Malagasy law: the Constitution (1992 Constitution as revised, 1998-2010; Constitution of 2010)
label: Madagascar
acts: Loi constitutionnelle n° 98-001 du 8 avril 1998 portant révision de la Constitution
Loi constitutionnelle n° 2007-001 du 27 avril 2007 portant révision de la Constitution
Loi constitutionnelle n° 2009-001 du 19 janvier 2009 modifiant les dispositions de l'article 15 de la Constitution
Constitution de la République de Madagascar du 11 décembre 2010 (Constitution de la Quatrième République)
record_note: From the 1998 revised text (in force 1998-04-10 at the earliest) to the Constitution of 11 December 2010 (in force 2010-12-11); CNLEGIS lists no constitutional act after 2010 on 2026-10-28, the day the data was retrieved and checked.

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: immediate effect without retroactivity (Ordonnance n° 62-041 du 19 septembre 1962, art. 8); no punishment without a law promulgated and published before the act (Constitution 2010, art. 13)
default_reach.meaning: a new law applies to situations already established when it does not alter the effects already produced by an earlier legal situation; procedural laws apply to pending cases not yet decided on the merits; interpretive laws reach back only where the legislature clearly says so
default_reach.authority: Ordonnance n° 62-041 du 19 septembre 1962 relative aux dispositions générales de droit interne et de droit international privé, art. 8 (CNLEGIS, uploads/O62-041-VF.pdf); Constitution du 11 décembre 2010, art. 13

replayed: partial: only the 2009 version (LC 2009-001, article 15) is replayed; the 1998, 2007 and 2010 versions are whole official texts
